statement: Is there an algorithm for b-Chromatic Number running in time 2n nO(1) ?
context: In this paper we studied b-Chromatic Number in the realm of parameterized and exact algorithm and resolved the parameterized complexity of the problem. We would like to conclude with two concrete open problems. Is there an algorithm for b-Chromatic Number running in time 2n nO(1) ? Does there exist an XP algorithm for b-Chromatic Number? Is the problem of finding a b-chromatic core of order k FPT when parameterized by k?
